run.requirements: Source-verified owner-selectable Delta V3 pools with isolated Yield Bank accounting

summary.building: Pool-neutral Delta V3 strategies selected per Yield Bank owner
summary.topRisk: Proxy implementations and live pool state can change after review
summary.mustDecideFirst: Use one isolated sleeve and adapter per admitted pool with an independent reference source
summary.watchOutFor: Pool existence does not prove token, liquidity, oracle, or eligibility safety

risks.title: Permissionless pool admission
risks.detail: An existing pool may contain an unsuitable token and must pass deterministic admission checks.

risks.title: Public RPC throttling
risks.detail: Activation and transaction construction require redundant production RPC endpoints.

risks.title: Unversioned deployment and proxy drift
risks.detail: Builder dependencies, token proxy implementations, pool graph, and runtime hashes must be re-read at activation.

risks.title: Position-NFT custody
risks.detail: Every returned position must be enumerated, identity-checked, and fully exit-capable.

risks.title: Thin or manipulable pools
risks.detail: Factory authenticity does not prove external price integrity or adequate liquidity.

risks.title: Pool state changes
risks.detail: Liquidity, observation history, lock state, price deviation, and execution minima require live checks.

preCodingDecisions.title: Pool isolation model
preCodingDecisions.detail: Use a separate restricted share sleeve and adapter for every admitted Delta pool.

preCodingDecisions.title: Independent pricing
preCodingDecisions.detail: A pool-derived TWAP requires a separate manifest-bound reference source.

requirementsCorrections.detail: The live builder does not require $INJOH; the paired asset is pool-specific.
Existing pools require factory, token, route, oracle, liquidity, cap, and codehash validation.
Production $INJOH token, pool, routes, feed, and threshold values have not yet been provided.
The operations reserve and its fee legs were not requested and were removed.
